column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:decision module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable DSL module for declarative decision logic, written entirely in
# AQL. Import binds the `Decision` namespace, then words are called via
# dot-access: `"aql:decision" import end  Decision.word args`. It exports
# refined Record TYPES (Cond, Pred, Rule, DTable, DTree, BranchNode,
# LeafNode), builder words that construct those records, and evaluators
# that run conditions / predicates / tables / trees against an input map.
# §1  exported record types — each evaluates to its refine-Record shape
aql:decision import end Decision.Cond
column3: Cond: a single field/op/value condition

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.Pred
column3: Pred: a compound (all/any/not) predicate group

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.Rule
column3: Rule: a GENERIC when→then pairing — R is the result type

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.Rule of [Map]
column3: …instantiating recovers the concrete record shape

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.DTable
column3: DTable: generic in R (defaulted — rule lists give no direct evidence)

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.DTable of []
column3: …and fully defaults to the Any-result table

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.DTree
column3: DTree: generic in R, defaulted like DTable

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.BranchNode
column3: BranchNode: an interior tree node

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.LeafNode
column3: LeafNode: a terminal node, generic in its result type

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.LeafNode of [Integer]
column3: …instantiating pins the result field

column1: aql:decision import end (5 is Decision.Comparable)
column3: the scalar builtins expose the Comparable surface

column1: aql:decision import end ({a:1} is Decision.Comparable)
column3: …a map is not Comparable (no cmp contract)

column1: # §2  builders — construct condition / predicate / rule records
aql:decision import end Decision.cond age/q "gte" 18
column3: cond field op value → a Cond record

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.all-of [{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} {field:"score" op:"gt" value:50}]
column2: {kind:'group' op:'all' children:(quote [{field:'age' op:'gte' value:18} {field:'score' op:'gt' value:50}])}
column3: all-of: every child must hold

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.any-of [{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} {field:"score" op:"gt" value:50}]
column2: {kind:'group' op:'any' children:(quote [{field:'age' op:'gte' value:18} {field:'score' op:'gt' value:50}])}
column3: any-of: at least one child must hold

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.not-of {field:"age" op:"lt" value:18}
column3: not-of: negate a single condition

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.make-rule {field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} {category:"adult"}
column3: make-rule when then → a Rule record

column1: # §3  table & tree builders
aql:decision import end Decision.make-table [{when:{field:"age" op:"lt" value:18} then:{category:"minor"}} {when:{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} then:{category:"adult"}}]
column2: {kind:'table' rules:(quote [{then:{category:'minor'} when:{field:'age' op:'lt' value:18}} {then:{category:'adult'} when:{field:'age' op:'gte' value:18}}]) hit-policy:'first'}
column3: make-table defaults to the 'first' hit policy

column1: aql:decision import end def t (Decision.make-table [{when:{field:"x" op:"gt" value:0} then:{s:"pos"}}]) t "unique" Decision.with-policy
column3: with-policy swaps the hit policy on a table

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.make-branch root/q [{when:{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} next:"adult"}]
column3: make-branch id branches → a BranchNode record

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.make-leaf adult/q {category:"adult"}
column3: make-leaf id result → a LeafNode record

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.make-tree root/q [{id:"root" kind:"leaf" result:"x"}]
column3: make-tree root nodes → a DTree record

column1: # §4  apply-op — the primitive comparison applied by eval-cond.
# The relational form is generic over the Comparable SURFACE
# (gen [(T extends Comparable)]) — non-Comparable operands are a loud
# signature error, not a silent false.
aql:decision import end Decision.apply-op 18 "gte" 25
column3: lhs=25 gte rhs=18 → true

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.apply-op 25 "gte" 18
column3: lhs=18 gte rhs=25 → false

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.apply-op "a" "lt" "b"
column3: Strings are Comparable (lhs='b' lt rhs='a' → false)

column1: aql:decision import end Decision.apply-op {a:1} "lt" 5
column3: a map is not Comparable — the bounded sig rejects it and the Any overload raises on the ordering op

column1: # §5  eval-cond — test one condition against an input map
aql:decision import end {age:25} {field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} Decision.eval-cond
column3: age 25 satisfies gte 18

column1: aql:decision import end {age:15} {field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} Decision.eval-cond
column3: age 15 fails gte 18

column1: # §6  eval-pred — evaluate a compound predicate
aql:decision import end def p (Decision.all-of [{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} {field:"score" op:"gt" value:50}]) {age:25 score:80} p Decision.eval-pred
column3: all-of holds for age=25, score=80

column1: # §7  eval-table / eval-tree / decide — full evaluators

aql:decision import end def tbl (Decision.make-table [{when:{field:"age" op:"lt" value:18} then:{category:"minor"}} {when:{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} then:{category:"adult"}}]) {age:25} tbl Decision.eval-table
column3: first matching rule wins

column1: aql:decision import end def tree ({kind:"tree" root:"root" nodes:[{id:"root" kind:"branch" branches:[{when:{field:"age" op:"lt" value:18} next:"minor"} {when:{field:"age" op:"gte" value:18} next:"adult"}]} {id:"minor" kind:"leaf" result:"too-young"} {id:"adult" kind:"leaf" result:"welcome"}]}) {age:25} tree Decision.eval-tree
column3: walk a branch to its leaf result

column1: aql:decision import end def model ({kind:"table" hit-policy:"first" rules:[{when:{field:"x" op:"gt" value:0} then:{sign:"positive"}}]}) {x:5} model Decision.decide
column3: decide dispatches on model kind (table/tree)
